method: Before task freezing and model execution, a separate parent agent inspected all nineteen case facts, claim contracts, expected labels, requested numeric values and recommendation operations. The contextual-skill agent corroborated scoped governance and lifecycle semantics.
status: Accepted as internally coherent controlled development references; not owner validation, independent real-world ground truth, or held-out audit accuracy.
limitations: Reviewer agents share the same project context and are not independent human auditors.
The first eighteen cases were reviewed before the final exact-governance-expectation question was added; the contextual-skill agent separately corroborated that expectation.
No explanation-usefulness score or external label validation was performed.
